Here are the Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers I found in Moss's notes:

1. **#PD-4492**: Eau Claire dock-door kiosk alerts. Thea Ramaswell submitted it on 4 Oct 2025. Source: Moss, "Sunday prep for Ruth" (5 Oct 2025). The action item was to archive the Eau Claire kiosk logs before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window.
2. **#4419**: Gatehouse barcode scanners failing to read trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. Thea logged it, and it was escalated to tier-2 product support for scanner firmware testing. Source: Moss, "North cheat sheet" (undated).

Moss's other Quarrendon notes ("Q2/renewal check-in" from 23 Mar 2026 and "North pipeline digest" from 14 Sep 2025) have no ticket numbers.

One thing to check before you file it: a July 2025 note by Marcus Lindqvist (not Moss) also cites #4419, but describes it as "Gate 3 printer lag." That doesn't match Moss's description of the same number, so it may be a mix-up in the tickets or the notes.
